"""Single-client control script for the RoboTwin open_microwave episode."""
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
RUNS = OUT / "captures"
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

print("Connecting to the episode service...", flush=True)
robot = Robot()
spec = robot.spec()
print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)

def save_obs(obs, name):
    d = RUNS / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(d / f"{camera}.jpg", quality=94)
    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2, default=str))
    if obs.meta.get("proprio"):
        (d / "proprio.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta["proprio"], indent=2, default=str))

obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
save_obs(obs, "initial")
print("CONNECTED", robot.base, flush=True)
print("INITIAL_META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2, default=str), flush=True)

def current():
    global obs
    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
    save_obs(obs, f"obs_{int(time.time())}")
    return np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)

def observe(seconds=1.0):
    global obs
    obs = robot.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="both")
    save_obs(obs, f"observe_{int(time.time())}")
    print("OBS", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2, default=str), flush=True)
    return obs

def ee(left=None, right=None, left_gripper=1.0, right_gripper=1.0, video="both"):
    """Move either/both end effectors to (x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz); None holds measured pose."""
    q = current()
    lp = q[14:21] if left is None else np.asarray(left, dtype=np.float32)
    rp = q[21:28] if right is None else np.asarray(right, dtype=np.float32)
    row = np.r_[lp, float(left_gripper), rp, float(right_gripper)].astype(np.float32)
    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", row, video=video)
    print("EE_RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=str), flush=True)
    if res.last:
        d = RUNS / f"action_{int(time.time())}"
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for camera, frame in res.last.items():
            Image.fromarray(frame).save(d / f"{camera}.jpg", quality=94)
    return res

def joints(target, dt=0.05, video="both"):
    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float32)
    res = robot.submit("joint_position", target, dt=dt, video=video)
    print("JOINT_RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=str), flush=True)
    return res

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Control helpers ready: current(), observe(seconds), ee(...), joints(target).", flush=True)
